metadata.name: AI Translate
metadata.author: 369 / community
metadata.description: Four API formats with v96-inspired key/model failover, chunking, named prompts and book dictionaries. Based on Gemini Translate by 369/3690.

API_URL.title: API base URL (blank = official; compatible requires URL including /v1 or provider prefix)

API_KEY.title: API key (optional only for keyless OpenAI-compatible servers)

MODEL.title: Model ID (required; use an exact ID available from your provider)

MAX_TOKENS.title: Max output tokens (including reasoning, where applicable)

TEMPERATURE.title: Temperature (blank = provider default; some models require blank)

API_KEYS.title: API keys, one per line (overrides single key; same provider only)

KEY_FAILOVER.title: Try next key on HTTP 401/403/429
KEY_FAILOVER.subtitle: Additional requests; at most 6 attempts per chunk.

MODEL_LIST.title: Additional model IDs, one per line (picker and fallback order)

MODEL_FAILOVER.title: Try fallback models
MODEL_FAILOVER.subtitle: May incur additional charges. HTTP 404/429/500/502/503 only; never refusal or incomplete output.

TOP_K.title: Gemini Top K (blank = omitted, 1–100; ignored for other providers)

CHUNK_CONTEXT.title: Send previous chunk ending for consistency
CHUNK_CONTEXT.subtitle: Adds up to 500 translated characters to the next request within this text block.

PROMPT_PRESETS.title: Named prompts as JSON: {"wuxia":"Use formal dialogue."}

USE_GLOSSARY.title: Use shared/book glossary and vBook name dictionaries

USE_NAME_FILTER.title: Suggest recurring Chinese names
USE_NAME_FILTER.subtitle: Heuristic guidance, not source replacement; may include false positives.

NAME_REPEAT.title: Minimum name occurrences per text block

NAME_SURNAMES.title: Chinese surnames, one per line
